## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Ma's Kitchen?
Plot No. 109, 'B' Block, Kundalakesi Street, Ganesh Nagar, Selaiyur, Chennai 600 073 (Contact: Manoharan).

### What facilities does Ma's Kitchen have?
Wedding catering, Wedding planning (A to Z), Corporate catering, Birthday menus, Seemantham / valaikaapu menu, Housewarming functions, Live food stalls, Fruit & vegetable carving, Deepavali & Ayudha Pooja sweets, Flowers, lighting & music on request.

### How many guests can Ma's Kitchen cater?
From 50 to 10,000 people, for weddings, corporate events and private parties.

### Can Ma's Kitchen arrange more than food?
Yes. As wedding planners they can arrange flowers, lighting, music and A to Z marriage arrangements.

### How do I book Ma's Kitchen?
